## ProofService.processRequest() method

Process a received [RequestPresentationMessage](./core.requestpresentationmessage.md). This will not accept the presentation request or send a presentation. It will only create a new, or update the existing proof record with the information from the presentation request message. Use [ProofService.createPresentation()](./core.proofservice.createpresentation.md) after calling this method to create a presentation.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
processRequest(messageContext: InboundMessageContext<RequestPresentationMessage>): Promise<ProofRecord>;
```

| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| messageContext | [InboundMessageContext](./core.inboundmessagecontext.md)&lt;[RequestPresentationMessage](./core.requestpresentationmessage.md)&gt; | The message context containing a presentation request message |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[ProofRecord](./core.proofrecord.md)&gt;

proof record associated with the presentation request message
